title: Full-data accuracy with fewer labels for training and fine-tuning machine-learning force fields
abstract: arXiv:2607.14486v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Machine-learning force fields (MLFFs) are reliable only near their training distribution, making efficient construction of diverse training sets a major bottleneck for both train-from-scratch and foundation fine-tuning workflows. Active learning can reduce this cost, but standard model-committee uncertainty is impractical for foundation MLFFs because each committee member requires a separate fine-tuning run. We present an active-learning workflow based on last-layer-projection regression (LLPR), a forward-pass-cheap per-configuration uncertainty estimator. Across molecular, condensed-phase, and electrolyte systems, LLPR identifies compact, high-value training sets that recover full-data accuracy using only a small fraction of electronic-structure labels. translated_title: 以更少标注实现机器学习力场训练与微调的全数据精度
translated_abstract: 机器学习力场（MLFFs）仅在其训练分布附近才是可靠的，这使得高效构建多样化训练集成为从零开始训练和基础模型微调工作流程中的一个主要瓶颈。主动学习可以降低这一成本，但标准的模型委员会不确定性估计方法对于基础MLFFs并不实用，因为每个委员会成员都需要单独进行一次微调运行。我们提出了一种基于最后一层投影回归（LLPR）的主动学习工作流程，LLPR是一种前向传播成本低、可对每个构型进行不确定性估计的方法。在分子、凝聚相和电解质体系中，LLPR能够识别出紧凑且高价值的训练集，仅使用一小部分电子结构标注即可恢复全数据精度。在基础模型微调中，LLPR选择的构型以远少于随机选择所需的标注数量接近了实际微调性能上限。在迭代电子结构……
tldr: 该论文提出基于最后一层投影回归（LLPR）的主动学习工作流程，只需一小部分电子结构标注即可在机器学习力场的从零训练和基础模型微调中达到全数据训练精度。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an active-learning workflow based on last-layer-projection regression (LLPR) that achieves full-data accuracy in both training and fine-tuning machine-learning force fields using only a small fraction of electronic-structure labels.
